results.title: Leia mentors a reluctant Rey in 'Star Wars: Legacy' – Exclusive sneak peak
results.description: Rey and Leia didn't share a lot of screen time in the "Star Wars" movies but the duo headlines new book "Legacy." Read the exclusive opening scene.

results.title: Keigo Higashino, Author of 'The Devotion of Suspect X,' Dies of Colon Cancer at Age 68, Leaving a Legacy
results.description: Keigo Higashino, famed Japanese mystery novelist, has died at 68 from colon cancer. His works, including 'The Devotion of Suspect X,' continue to captivate readers worldwide.
